ITEM 1 | Eleven or so small oval pieces, about 1.5–2.5 cm long, clustered in the lower-left of a white square dish; dark reddish-brown to maroon, slightly wrinkled, moist-looking with a faint sheen; one tiny fragment sits apart above the cluster | 25
ITEM 2 | Thin, straight, bright green stalks, about 6–8 cm long and roughly 0.3–0.5 cm thick, with some pale tips; partly visible at the top-left edge of a white plate, lying flat and slightly overlapping | 15
ITEM 3 | Tan to light-brown piece with a rough, slightly fibrous surface, roughly 4 cm across, partly cut off by the left edge of the frame; sits on the white plate beside the green stalks | 30
ITEM 4 | Off-white creamy dollop, about 3 cm across and mounded, with a soft, matte surface and slightly uneven edges; sits next to the tan piece on the white plate | 15
ITEM 5 | Three glossy red round pieces, about 1.5–2 cm in diameter, smooth skin with a slight sheen; partly visible at the left edge of the white plate, below the green stalks | 20
